sentences.text: The Common Carder Bee is an insect in the order Hymenoptera and is assessed by the IUCN Red List as LC (least concern).
In Mainz-Bingen, 572 reports have been logged in ten years, with a main time from April to September and most reports in August.
It has been recorded eating Red Clover, Oregano, Blueweed and White Clover, among other plants.
Goldenrod Crab Spider is recorded as a predator.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Marsh Thistle, Greater Knapweed, Meadow vetchling and Foxglove.
